capabilities: Search file names and individual lines with fuzzy, typo-tolerant matching
Rank results by relevance with order-aware scoring and open matches at the exact line
Chat with a Gemini AI assistant grounded in a file, folder, or the whole vault
Toggle Google Search grounding for web results alongside vault answers
Exclude folders and tune minimum query length and result limits
extras: Not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Web search grounding requires a Gemini API paid tier; the AI key is stored via the Obsidian keychain, not plaintext settings. Fuzzy search is fully local; only the chat panel sends note content to Google.
intentEvidence: Standard search tools often fail to locate these details or return irrelevant results.
problem: Standard search misses details captured in daily notes without tags or backlinks, and can't answer complex questions synthesized from note content.
summary: Line-level fuzzy search over file names and Markdown content, plus an optional Gemini AI chat panel that answers questions grounded in vault notes.
